purpose: G2 ROI stereo-rebuild probe: keep the local ROI trigger thresholds but disable async refresh and cached stereo reuse so refreshed ROI regions must rebuild stereo evidence from left/right IR.
expected_effect: Force ROI refresh to call stereo contour distance estimation for refreshed ROI regions.
Validate G2 separately from G1 by expecting roi_stereo_g2_rebuild_pass=1 on local_motion_roi_stereo_probe.
Keep the probe deterministic; do not use it as a live-motion performance candidate.
risk: Synchronous ROI stereo rebuild can increase refresh-frame latency.
The synthetic IR shift is a controlled stereo template probe, not proof of real-scene robustness.
